## Crystallized: OmegaTools
### An addon for Crystallized, which adds Tryinclatite/Omega tools to the game!

OmegaTools is an addon for my other mod (Crystallized)

OmegaTools adds an entire new tool-tier to your game, which is even better than Netherite! Like really, you can even instant-mine Stone with a full-enchanted Omega Pickaxe!
